((dear)) Mum and ((dad)),
I really love ((sweden))! I’m having so much fun here. Everything is so different, especially the nature. ((stockholm)), the capital of the country, is surrounded by water. You can take the metro everywhere, and the train stations are deep in the ground with ((Stone)) walls. In the summer, it’s always sunny, and the sun almost never sets. No matter how early ((i)) wake up, the sun is up. Today, I’m going to the Swedish ((history)) Museum with my class. I miss ((manchester)) and you both a lot. I’m really excited for you to visit me in ((october)). I can’t wait to show you where I go to school and hang out with my ((Friends)). Give my love to ((grandpa)) Jack.
((love)),
Samira
